'''Nogometni klub Brinje Grosuplje''' ({{langx|en|Brinje Grosuplje Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''Brinje Grosuplje''', is a Slovenian [[Association football|football]] club based in the town of [[Grosuplje]].<ref>{{cite web |title=View NK Brinje Grosuplje full team profile on Global Sports Archive: squad, fixtures, results, stats, standings, history and achievements |url=https://globalsportsarchive.com/en/soccer/team/nk-brinje-grosuplje/19035/overview |website=Global Sports Archive |access-date=2 June 2026}}</ref> As of 2026–27, they play in the [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]], the top tier of Slovenian football.

NK Brinje Grosuplje was founded in 2003.<ref name = "Brinje"/><ref name = "Klubi"/> The club is legally not considered to be the successor of [[NK Grosuplje (defunct)|NK Grosuplje]] and the statistics and honours of the two clubs are kept separate by the [[Football Association of Slovenia]].<ref name = "Klubi"/>"}}
